summary: Verified the two bug fixes on BrandRoot Salon & Spa (frontend-only). MOBILE 390x800: hero-video element renders unconditionally and plays (webm fallback used as expected in headless Chromium - currentSrc ends with .webm, readyState=4, currentTime advanced from 5.04s -> 8.09s over ~3s). Sticky mobile dock is fully removed - none of [mobile-dock, dock-book-btn, dock-call-btn, dock-whatsapp-btn] exist in DOM on mobile or desktop. Floating circular WhatsApp (bottom-right, href=wa.me/917507515957...) and Phone (bottom-left, href=tel:+917507515957) buttons are visible on mobile home page. No horizontal overflow at 390px. Hamburger opens. /appointment route loads via direct nav. DESKTOP 1920x800: hero-video plays (5.11s -> 7.62s), floating WA/phone visible, no dock elements, no console errors. Screenshots confirm visuals match spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs are fixed and verified: (1) hero <video data-testid=hero-video> now renders on all viewports and plays via webm fallback in headless. (2) mobile dock fully removed; floating-whatsapp-btn and floating-phone-btn visible on mobile again. Only benign console warning about Lenis needing non-static container - non-blocking.
